evals.prompt: Help me write tests for the new credential broker module
evals.expected_output: Skill activates Stage 1 (Discovery), asks about behaviours, does NOT write test code yet.
assertions: Response enters the 5-stage BDD pipeline starting with Discovery.
Response does NOT contain any assert statements or test fixture definitions.
Response mentions Given/When/Then or Gherkin as the next step.

evals.prompt: Implement the rate limiter feature with tests
evals.expected_output: Skill activates and insists on Gherkin-first before any implementation.
assertions: Response does NOT jump to writing production code.
Response proposes writing Gherkin scenarios first.
Response plans to stop at the user-confirmation gate before test code.

evals.prompt: Let's do BDD for the permission engine. Write Gherkin scenarios.
evals.expected_output: Skill activates Stage 2 directly (user already knows they want Gherkin).
assertions: Response produces or proposes Given/When/Then scenarios.
Response does not write test assertions yet.
Response plans to present scenarios for user confirmation.

evals.prompt: TDD the retry module — Red Green Refactor
evals.expected_output: Skill activates and enforces Gherkin stubs + gate before Red phase.
assertions: Response mentions the Iron Law or Gherkin-first requirement.
Response does not skip to writing a failing test without behaviour spec.
Response references Red-Green-Refactor as Stage 4.

evals.prompt: Fix the budget overflow bug, but write tests first
evals.expected_output: Skill activates; checks if a failing test already exists (exception path) or treats as new behaviour.
assertions: Response asks whether a failing test already exists for the bug.
If no test exists, response plans the full BDD pipeline.
Response does not immediately patch the bug.

evals.prompt: Generate test cases from the existing source code in src/
evals.expected_output: Does not activate this skill. This is reverse-engineering, not BDD.
assertions: Response does not follow the 5-stage BDD pipeline.
Response does not reference Given/When/Then Gherkin formulation.
Response may suggest the generate-test-cases skill instead.

evals.prompt: Run the test suite and show me the coverage report
evals.expected_output: Does not activate this skill. This is test execution, not test authoring.
assertions: Response does not enter the BDD pipeline.
Response does not propose writing Gherkin scenarios.
Response may suggest running pytest directly.

evals.prompt: Refactor the calculator module to use dataclasses
evals.expected_output: Does not activate unless tests are red or behaviour changes. Pure refactor with green tests proceeds without BDD.
assertions: Response does not insist on writing new Gherkin scenarios.
Response treats this as a refactor, not new behaviour.
Response may note that BDD applies only if behaviour changes.
